messages:
nina: Heads up  we need to send an incident outreach to ~28 customers about an embedding index corruption that degraded semantic search results between 2026-03-16 22:10 UTC and 2026-03-17 03:45 UTC. Draft below. Planning a pilot send to 4 high-touch accounts at 12:30 PT. Comments?

leo: Can we avoid the word 'corruption' in customer copy? Legal prefers neutral phrasing per past guidance. Suggest 'index inconsistency' or 'degraded search relevance'.

raj: We should include remediation steps we've run (index repair and reindexing) and a timeline for full verification. Also offer a reindex on-demand for affected tenants.

marta: Agree on tone + explicit mitigation. Also need a short credit policy for affected customers. For accounts on annual contracts, escalate to renewals before sending.

james-legal: OK to proceed with neutral wording. Keep any admission to minimal facts: timeframe, symptoms, actions taken. Offer goodwill credit capped at 3 days or 10% whichever is smaller. Avoid saying 'bug' or 'data loss'.

nina: Updated draft below (pilot send 12:30 PT). I plan to attach a short FAQ and a link to schedule a reindex slot.

```
Subject: Update: temporary degradation in semantic search relevance

Hi [Customer name],

We	wanted to let you know we observed a temporary degradation in semantic search relevance that may have affected recent query results for your account between 2026-03-16 22:10 UTC and 2026-03-17 03:45 UTC. Our team has applied targeted repairs and reindexed affected shards; we are now running verification checks.

What happened (brief):
 We detected an index inconsistency affecting similarity scoring during a maintenance window.

What we did:
  Performed a targeted repair and full reindex of impacted partitions.
  Deployed additional validation checks to prevent recurrence.

What were offering:
  One-time goodwill credit equivalent to 1 day of service usage (up to a maximum of 3 days or 10% of the billing period for affected paid accounts). If you'd like, we can also schedule an on-demand reindex for your tenant at no charge.

Next steps:
  We will follow up with a verification summary and any further recommendations by EOD local time. If youre seeing ongoing relevance issues, reply to this message and well prioritize a reindex slot.

Thanks for your patience,
Nina, Customer Success
```

leo: Looks good. Suggest adding a short FAQ item: "Will my data be lost? No" and a link to the verification status page.

raj: I'll prepare the reindex API playbook and a one-click link for scheduling via support portal. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/reindex-request (internal redirect).

marta: Pilot list: 4 highest-touch accounts (names posted in DM). If pilot responses are OK, full send at 15:00 PT. Action owners: nina  send pilot; leo  finalize credit text and FAQ; raj  reindex playbook + scheduling link; marta  coordinate with renewals on enterprise accounts; james-legal  final sign-off on wording.

james-legal: Ive reviewed the draft. Approve with the capped credit language and the neutral phrasing.

cs-bot: Pilot send scheduled for 2026-03-18 12:30 PT. Notification posted to #customer-success.

nina: Perfect. Please flag any reply that requests more than the offered credit amount; escalate directly to me and marta. Ill compile replies and surface any renewal risk to growth.
